title: China 2027 Verified Trip Planner — Beijing & Shanghai
subtitle: Primary-Source Verified Hotels, MICHELIN Dining, Activities, Multi-Platform Reviews & Itineraries for Two Adults
scope_note: Self-contained dual-city verified study published under china-2027/ alongside sibling single-city and social-audit directories in this repository.

trip_brief.preferred_start: 2027-02-15 to 2027-02-18; meaning unresolved. If interpreted as check-in Feb 15 and checkout Feb 18, that is 3 nights, shorter than the requested 7-night minimum. No interpretation is assumed.
target_durations: 1–2 weeks (7–14 days; current examples: 7 nights and 14 days / 13 nights)
trip_brief.hotel_requirements: Requested: private/attached bathroom and a queen or king bed; target hotel-to-restaurant/activity journeys of 60 minutes or less by subway/bus. No exact hotel-to-venue routes have been verified, so no property is certified for the time limit and the displayed order is provisional. Prices are dated Booking.com 7-night quote snapshots for specified stay dates; the 13-night total and cheapest date to purchase are not established.

calendar_2027.source_title: State Council General Office — 2027 Public Holiday Schedule (published 2026-11-06)
calendar_2027.lantern_festival: 2027-02-20 (Sat) — 15th day of Lunar Month 1 (festive evening lanterns in Beijing & Shanghai Yuyuan; not a statutory bank holiday)
calendar_2027.key_implication: The official Spring Festival public holiday ended Feb 13; the Hong Kong Observatory calendar places Lantern Festival on Feb 20. If the stated preferred Feb 15–18 interval means check-in Feb 15 and checkout Feb 18, it is 3 nights and below the 7-night minimum; its meaning remains unresolved. The 7-night and 14-day / 13-night examples include Feb 20, but that does not imply a flexible-start interpretation. Hotel stay-date comparisons vary: Grand Millennium Beijing was captured at $783 for Mar 1–8 and $838 for Feb 15–22. No purchase date is recommended.
calendar_risks: Post-Chunyun return travel (Feb 14-21): High-speed rail tickets on Beijing-Shanghai corridors can sell quickly right after Spring Festival; book on 12306 the day tickets release (typically 15 days before departure — confirm exact 2027 window on 12306.cn).

Early March NPC/CPPCC ('Two Sessions') in Beijing: Annual parliamentary meetings typically convene in early March, creating heightened security checks around Tian'anmen Square, Great Hall of the People, and Chang'an Avenue. Touring central Beijing in Feb 15-22 avoids early-March central-axis disruptions.

hsr_beijing_shanghai.route: Beijing South Railway Station <-> Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station (~1,300 km)
hsr_beijing_shanghai.duration: Fastest Fuxing G-trains ~4.5-5.5 hr; standard G-trains 5-6 hr

beijing_subway.fares: Distance-based: CNY 3 (<=6 km), CNY 4 (6-12 km), CNY 5 (12-22 km), CNY 6 (22-32 km), +CNY 1 per 20 km beyond 32 km. Capital Airport Express: flat CNY 25.
beijing_subway.network_update: Subway Line 17 central section (Workers' Stadium-Shilihe), Line 18, and Line 6 southern extension opened 2025-12-27, strengthening direct north-south rail links across Chaoyang CBD and Sanlitun.

shanghai_metro.fares: Distance-based (2005 schedule): CNY 3 (<=6 km), +CNY 1 per 10 km. Passes: 1-Day CNY 18, 3-Day CNY 45, Maglev+1-Day Metro CNY 55 (1-way) / CNY 85 (round-trip). Airport Link Line (Hongqiao<->Pudong ~40 min): CNY 4-26. Tap-to-Ride supports international Visa/Mastercard/Amex/JCB contactless cards at gates.
shanghai_metro.fare_review_flag: FLAGGED: On 2026-08-20 Shanghai published two fare-adjustment proposals (~+CNY 1/trip average) ahead of a 2026-09-07 public hearing. Re-verify final 2027 fare table before departure.
